faq.a1: Yes. Every assistant is trained on your services, prices, hours, and tone of voice. Customers won't know it's AI unless you tell them.
faq.a2: It only answers from information you approve. Anything it's unsure about gets escalated to you or your team instantly — never guessed.
faq.a3: No. It plugs into the website, phone number, and calendar you already have. Nothing to install, nothing to learn.
faq.a4: You get a report: calls answered, bookings made, reviews collected. If the numbers don't impress you, we remove everything. No charge, no hard feelings.
faq.a5: Because that's where the pain is worst — missed calls, no-shows, dead lead lists — and where automation pays for itself fastest.
faq.a6: We build and launch your pilot within 7 days — you approve everything before it goes live.
faq.a7: No. The pilot is free, Launch is one-time, and Growth is month-to-month. Cancel anytime.
faq.a8: Any business that takes calls, books appointments, or chases leads — restaurants, salons, plumbers, dentists, auto shops, contractors, clinics, and more. Try the demo above in your industry.
faq.a9: Flo doesn't replace your team — it covers what they can't: nights, weekends, lunch rushes, and the 3rd call ringing while they're with a customer. Think of it as the employee who never sleeps.
